messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English between two consenting adults in an established romantic relationship while doing an ordinary household chore. Keep the affection casual and integrated into the routine. Show closeness through touch, teasing, practical consideration, and comfortable conversation. Keep it non-explicit and avoid idealized declarations.

Morgan folded the last towel and held it out.

“Your turn.”

Casey took it. “I folded the last one.”

“You folded two.”

“That counts.”

“No.”

Casey put the towel on the stack.

“You're very strict.”

“I have standards.”

“You're folding bath towels like you're running a military operation.”

Morgan smiled. “You say that like it's a bad thing.”

Casey stepped closer and tucked a loose strand of hair behind Morgan's ear.

“You missed one.”

“What?”

“Nothing.”

Morgan looked at her for a second.

“Dish towel.”

“Right.”

Casey handed it over.

Morgan folded it and set it on the counter.

“Done.”

Casey reached for the basket.

“I've got it.”

“You said that last time.”

“And then you carried it anyway.”

“Because you dropped a sock.”

“It was one sock.”

“It was in the hallway.”

Casey laughed.

Morgan picked up the basket.

“Come on.”

They started toward the bedroom.

Halfway there, Casey caught Morgan's hand.

Morgan looked back.

“What?”

Casey kissed her cheek.

“Nothing.”

Morgan smiled and squeezed her hand.

“Okay.”

They kept walking, carrying the laundry between them.
